title: Space
story: Gear for a cozy trip among the stars.

cards.name: Rocket
cards.subject: A classic symmetrical rocket flying upward with a pointed nose cone, a round porthole, three fins and an engine nozzle.
cards.hero_colors: white body with red nose and fins and a yellow porthole

cards.hero_colors: grey with a yellow row of buttons
cards.surface_or_setting: metal deck floor of a spaceship cabin with a plain wall behind

cards.name: Data Pad
cards.subject: A flat rectangular tablet with rounded corners and a thin frame, its screen showing a simple map icon with a pin, lying flat.
cards.hero_colors: dark grey frame with a pale screen and a green pin

cards.hero_colors: gold foil body with navy solar panels
